output.name: Tiru
output.myth: Tiru went out in the red-sailed boat when the Gale was young, and Tavo took it and did not give it back. His mother flew his red kite from the cliff each night into the wind, so a lamp would show to the boats still out. Hesk counts the string, and she counted it every night. Nobody told her to stop. Hesk knotted the ferry Mesul's mast to that same string. The Iron Kettle to the north-west sat on the hearth full of sea-water, and nobody sat by it. The ray Halvun in the Unflown saw the boat go first, and she is no fish. One evening Tavo came back laughing, and the wind pulled the kite from her hands. It went up past the Gull Who Lost a Word, which watches from the north-east, and into Vel. It did not come down. Now the red lamp hangs low over the Leeward Reach, and it burns on nights when a boat is still out. If you see it, do not wave. Tiru is in the boat. Keep your own lamp lit and come home by it.
output.finding: Find the Iron Kettle low in the north-west of the Leeward Reach, then look about one hand-span south-east of it for the red lamp.
